author: Mark Atwood
text:
Two equally-plausible idiomatic resolutions with public-API breaking outcomes either way. Defer to human.

CURRENT SHAPE
- pub struct Sha256DigestError { pub kind: Sha256DigestErrorKind } — wrapper struct that delegates Display to self.kind.
- pub enum Sha256DigestErrorKind { WrongLength { got }, NonHexLowercase { at } } — the real variants.
- Both are #[non_exhaustive]; variants got per-variant #[non_exhaustive] in bd:JMAP-sf5h.10.

OPTIONS

(a) Drop the wrapper. Rename Sha256DigestErrorKind to Sha256DigestError; the enum IS the error type.
    - Matches the canonical pattern for crate-internal error enums where no extra context is wanted.
    - Callers write match err { ... } instead of match err.kind { ... }.
    - Drops one struct from the public surface; the per-variant #[non_exhaustive] still guards forward-compat.
    - Closes bd:JMAP-sf5h.21 with minimum disruption.
    - Breaking change post-publish (renames an exported type).

(b) Commit to the wrapper and put real context fields on it.
    - bd:JMAP-sf5h.14 (use NonZeroU8 / bounded type for WrongLength.got) and bd:JMAP-sf5h.15 (add offending byte value to NonHexLowercase) point at fields that could live on the wrapper.
    - Wrapper could carry input length + a snippet of the offending input + the byte value at the failed position.
    - Lets the enum keep its discriminant set stable while the wrapper grows context.

RECOMMENDATION: (a).
- Two-tier error patterns pay off when the wrapper carries context the enum cannot reasonably hold (source location, span, backtrace). For a 64-character ABNF check, the position the enum already carries IS the context.
- Workspace canonical-templates rule: sibling jmap-types Id parse error follows a single-type pattern, not two-tier. Diverging here without a real reason fragments the workspace error idiom.

CASCADE IF (a) ACCEPTED: rename Sha256DigestErrorKind → Sha256DigestError, drop the old struct. .14 / .15 remain open and address the variants directly (they already do; the wrapper question is independent). Workspace fmt/clippy/test + cargo public-api before publish.

CASCADE IF (b) ACCEPTED: keep both names; design what context fields go on the wrapper, file a follow-up bead with the concrete field set, land .14 / .15 simultaneously to flesh out the variants in parallel.
